root_instrumented_start.scope: Instrumented B3 review/validation portion; initial plan verification excluded; not measured human analyst hours

timing.basis: Actual instrumented reviewer walltime from first assigned source inspection to completed local records; includes model/tool waiting and is not human analyst hours.

timing.timing_boundary: Explicit timing begins after initial assigned-input read; earlier local input inspection is not included.
timing.human_effort: Not measured; elapsed reviewer wall time is not human labor hours.

timing.preinstrumentation_activity: Read assigned input and original review questions; no external requests or manuscripts.
timing.interpretation: Measured elapsed analyst-agent wall time, including waiting and tool overhead. Not an estimate of human labor hours.

human_effort_limitation: AI-assisted wall time includes waiting/tool overhead and overlapping reviewers; human labor was not timed. Do not equate summed worker or elapsed minutes with human analyst hours.
calibration: This is a bounded metadata batch with three local-ready cases, not calibration for method/evaluation-heavy scientific batches. Actual parallel elapsed is recorded; no unsupported human-hour conversion.

local_fastlane.cost_scope: External source/API spend; model cost not measured

group_a.external_cost: No purchase/paidAPI used; tool billing not exposed. Monetary total unknown, not invented.
group_a.HTTP_statuses: Not supplied by web tool; serialized capture sizes are not network transfer sizes.

group_b.web_tool_transport_request_count_duratio: Not exposed by web tool; do not combine opaque tool operations with measured direct HTTP requests as an exact wire-request total.
group_b.raw_html_captures: Metadata-only public landing pages, not PDF/full manuscripts. No supplements retrieved.

request_total_limitation: Web-tool search/open/find operations are recorded separately; exact transport request count/bytes/duration is unavailable. Serialized capture sizes are storage costs, not network transfer sizes. No paid source was used.
raw_elapsed_interpretation: Includes prolonged interruption/idle interval and possible host sleep; monotonic and UTC wall durations are not active analyst effort. Primary reviewer timings remain the separately measured 20.54 aggregate worker-minutes. Human hours unknown.
direct_http_count_unit: Three successful logical urllib metadata capture operations; redirects/hops were not separately counted. Exact total wire-request count remains unknown.
